title: The Overturned Cart
text: A cart lies on its side in a ditch, wheels in the air, its mule long gone. Sacks of grain have split open in the mud. There is a locked chest among them, and a smell of something that is not grain, sweet and heavy, and the flies are thick.

options.label: The craftiest picks the chest's lock, before whoever owned it comes looking.

outcomes.text: Coin, and a letter that someone in town would pay to see.
A needle in the lock, and something on the needle.

options.label: The hardiest goes down into the ditch, to learn what the sweet smell is.

outcomes.text: Whatever ate the mule is still in the ditch, and it is still hungry.

options.label: Take the grain and go, before the flies find out who you are.

outcomes.text: Bread for a week, from the sacks the flies have not found.
